 Islanders at Stars projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 October 25, 2026 
 Link copied 
 ISLANDERS (5-3-2) at STARS (6-3-1) 
 6 p.m. ET; Prime Video, MSGSN 
 Islanders projected lineup 
 Simon Holmstrom -- Bo Horvat -- Kyle Palmieri
 Emil Heineman -- Brayden Schenn -- Victor Eklund
 Ondrej Palat -- Jean-Gabriel Pageau -- Anthony Duclair
 Kyle MacLean -- Casey Cizikas -- Mitchell Chaffee
 Logan Stanley – Matthew Schaefer
 Adam Pelech -- Ryan Pulock
 Matthew Kessel -- Tony DeAngelo
 Semyon Varlamov
 Ilya Sorokin
 Scratched: Scott Mayfield 
 Injured: Mathew Barzal (knee), Alexander Romanov (torn right ACL), Matias Maccelli (lower body), Calum Ritchie (lower body) 
 Stars projected lineup 
 Jason Robertson -- Roope Hintz -- Tyler Seguin
 Joel Kiviranta -- Wyatt Johnston --  Mikko Rantanen
 Justin Hryckowian -- Arttu Hyry -- Jamie Benn
 Dylan Hryckowian -- Colin Blackwell -- Matthew Seminoff
 Thomas Harley -- Miro Heiskanen
 Lian Bichsel -- Nils Lundkvist
 Kyle Capobianco -- Tyler Myers
 Jake Oettinger
 Casey DeSmith
 Scratched: David Perron 
 Injured: Radek Faksa (lower body), Sam Steel (undisclosed), Oskar Bäck (finger), Matt Duchene (lower body), Esa Lindell (lower body) 
 Status report 
 Steel will not play; the forward received an injection to treat his injury. ... Faksa is also out, and Perron is not ready to make his Stars debut. Hryckowian and Seminoff were recalled from Texas of the American Hockey League prior to game time.
